compute_ik_for_site_position: find joint positions that place a MuJoCo site at a target Cartesian position using inverse kinematics
compute_ik_for_site_orientation: find joint positions that orient a MuJoCo site to a target quaternion using inverse kinematics
compute_ik_for_site_pose: find joint positions satisfying both target position and orientation for a MuJoCo site using inverse kinematics
compute_ik_with_selected_joints: compute inverse kinematics for a MuJoCo site by manipulating only a specified subset of joints
calculate_joint_velocities_via_nullspace: calculate joint velocities to achieve an end-effector delta using the Jacobian transpose pseudoinverse or damped least squares method
